# Empowr Freelancer Network (EFN)

> The Empowr Freelancer Network (EFN) is a managed freelancer ecosystem operated by Empowr CIC, designed to connect skilled community members with paid freelance opportunities.

EFN handles onboarding, compliance verification, assignment matching, and payment processing — removing administrative burden from both clients and freelancers. It creates structured, supported pathways into self-employment for people from underrepresented backgrounds, combining professional opportunity with community mission.

## For Freelancers

- Guided onboarding and compliance verification
- Matched to assignments suited to your skills
- Supported payment processing through Empowr CIC

## For Clients

- Access to vetted, community-rooted freelance talent
- Managed compliance and onboarding handled by EFN
- Assignment coordination and accountability

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://efn.empowrcic.org): Overview of the Empowr Freelancer Network
- [Join as a Freelancer](https://efn.empowrcic.org/join): Onboarding entry point for new freelancers
- [Hire Talent](https://efn.empowrcic.org/hire): Entry point for clients seeking freelancers

## About

EFN is operated by Empowr CIC (empowrcic.org), a UK-based Community Interest Company.
